FPC1.role: sense lines SR1-SR16 -> mux I0-I15 (Top FPC, 12 fingers on pins 5-16 for the 12x32 sensor: mux channels 4-15)

header.part: Arduino Nano (U1, through-hole, not in the PnP)
header.pinOrder: pin 1 = TX (square pad) top-left, pins 1-15 run down the left row (x=8.509), pins 16-30 run up the right row (x=23.749); VIN = pin 30 (square)

mountingHoles.note: only drills are vias and header holes
